[[Star Wars (2015) 7|''Star Wars'' (2015) 7]] takes place a [[Standard year|year]] before [[Star Wars (2015) 15|''Star Wars'' (2015) 15]], which is set immediately before [[Star Wars (2015) 20|''Star Wars'' (2015) 20]]. In these [[Star Wars comic books|comics]], [[Owen Lars]] is visibly older than his appearance in ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of to [[9 BBY]]. Additionally, these comics depict [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[Ben Kenobi's home]], a home he did not occupy until after the events of ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'', meaning the comics have to take place after the series. However, [[Star Wars (LINE Webtoon)|''Star Wars'' LINE Webtoon]]: Chapter 2&mdash;"Meeting the Droids" depicts Obi-Wan Kenobi visibly older than his appearance in the aforementioned comics; ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' states that [[Luke Skywalker]] was twelve years old in the Webtoon chapter, and since he was [[Reproduction|born]] in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] according to ''Timelines'', he was twelve in [[7 BBY]] and this is the latest the comics can take place. Therefore, due to the year-long gap, ''Star Wars'' (2015) 7 is set in either 9 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] or [[8 BBY]], and ''Star Wars'' (2015) 15 and ''Star Wars'' (2015) 20 both take place in either 8 BBY or 7 BBY.<noinclude>
